# PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens

PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens is a clinical department within Denmark's psychiatric treatment system that appears in the 2024 ADHD database (ADHD_2024.pdf) as a consistently strong performer across several quality indicators for ADHD treatment. The clinic's results place it among a small group of departments nationally that come close to, or exceed, the national development goals set for ADHD treatment quality.

On the psychoeducation indicator — which measures the share of treatment courses where patients begin ADHD-related psychoeducation within 120 days of starting treatment — the clinic achieved 82% [^src1]. This was one of only three departments nationwide to reach 80% or above, alongside [[psy-lokalpsykiatri-toender|PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)]] at 83% and [[pmi-klinik-depression-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt]] at 80% [^src1]. This is notable in context: the national average for this indicator was only 36%, far below the 90% development goal, with the report noting substantial regional variation and registration problems, particularly in Region Nordjylland and Region Hovedstaden.

The clinic's strongest showing came on what the report labels [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]], which measures whether adult patients' social support needs were assessed within 120 days of starting treatment — the first year this indicator was reported. Here, the clinic recorded 143 out of 148 eligible courses meeting the standard, a rate of 97% (confidence interval 92–99%) [^src2]. This made it the only department among those with more than three patients nationwide to reach the indicator's development goal [^src2], a striking result set against a national fulfillment rate of just 37% and regional rates ranging from 14% to 52% [^src2]. The steering group behind the ADHD database discussed why fulfillment was so low nationally, pointing to registration practices and data quality from child/youth psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals as likely contributing factors, and resolved to work on improving registration practices going forward.

A third figure appears for the clinic in connection with a separate measure — 128 out of 148 courses, or 86% (confidence interval 80–92%) [^src3] — drawn from the report's Indikator 11 discussion, which tracks whether adult patients are in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a care pathway. This indicator was reported for adults for the first time in 2024, following the ADHD database's expansion that year to include adult patients, and the report notes wide regional variation on it (from 85% in Region Nordjylland to 37% in Region Hovedstaden), attributed largely to registration difficulties rather than genuine clinical differences.

Taken together, these results establish PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens as one of the best-performing units in the 2024 national ADHD quality reporting, particularly notable for being the sole department to meet the development goal on the social-support-needs indicator.
